configuration.distance_contract: accepted grid-distance naming: rotation-quotient L2 by declared-grid circular correlation; arbitrary rotations are approximate, grid-aligned rotations exact
configuration.independence_unit: master seed; factor-only producer derives law/side/row/attempt sub-seeds by BLAKE3
configuration.nominal_allocation: 24 requested accepted rows per population/side-count stratum; primal-hull triangles may exhaust under 128 attempts; zonogon only at sides 4,6
configuration.positive_gram_boundary: positive Gram participation ratio is not intrinsic or metric dimension; negative eigenmass only diagnoses failure of Euclidean embedding
configuration.raw_feature_boundary: raw unstandardized feature aggregates are scale-sensitive diagnostics; covariance_anisotropy can dominate and no aggregate is a score

allowed: per-seed and joint named contrasts, finite-panel effect sizes, rank/order stability, between-seed variability, acceptance/exhaustion/cost, and sign/order reversals
deferred: 4D exact reconstruction and structural product classification
inferential uncertainty beyond between-seed descriptive variability
prohibited: reusing this confirmation set to invent post-hoc criteria without labeling new exploration

observations.anisotropy: q95 >=10 is a finite-panel thin-tail flag; triangle emphasis remains a side-stratified contrast
observations.baseline_alpha1_overlap: named bidirectional overlap event is pass only when both directions are >=0.5 in every side stratum; no global ranking
observations.regular_controls: regular/mutation are local negative controls; alpha16/alpha4/alpha1 order is reported per side and seed, including reversals
observations.saturation: first deterministic prefix n with <=0.15 relative change is a descriptive saturation estimate only; narrow=(regular,regular-mutation,alpha16) versus broad=(alpha4,alpha1,current-baseline) is evaluated by first-stable medians, with unavailable values explicit
observations.zonogon_diversity: strong excess is predeclared as ratio >=2 at side 4 or 6; side 6 need not pass

producer_provenance.build_contract: cargo build --release --locked --package exp-sys-landscape --bin sys-datascience-generator-zoo-smoke at source_revision, with the source blobs and Cargo.lock above
producer_provenance.dirty_scope: producer reports separately record source_dirty for generator-zoo-smoke/main.rs and experiments/sys-landscape/Cargo.toml
